name: Sauce Essentials | 1g Live Resin Disposable | Green Crack
description:
A perennial favorite, Green Crack is a sativa-dominant hybrid that is massively potent, with a sweet flavor with tropical and citrus notes. The high is decidedly cerebral, with a big mood boost and a jolt of energy. This strain spurs creativity and helps patients get things done. It’s most effective in treating anxiety and depression, along with ADHD, PTSD, and migraines.

Taste: Citrus, Fruity, Pine, Sweet

Feel: Creative, Focus, Happy

Strain: Skunk #1
